newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: KIA PRECISION TO ABSORB KIA HEAVY.
newsitem.headline: KIA PRECISION TO ABSORB KIA HEAVY.

text.p: Kia Precision Works, a unit of South Korea's troubled Kia Group, would absorb its sister company Kia Heavy Industries Co Ltd by next May, the group said on Wednesday.
"The merger is in line with the group's restructuring programme," said a group spokesman.

The Kia Group, which has been put under protection by creditors until September 29 after running into financial troubles, earlier said it would reduce the number of its domestic subsidiaries to five from 28.

The group said the merger would raise 76.8 billion won through some asset sales and reduce its workforce by 514. As a result, the group said it would cut its debts by 151.5 billion won. Kia Group's debts stood at 9.5 trillion won as of the end of May.
